changed.note: utcnow() returns datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc); removed PYTHON_311 branch that stripped tzinfo
unix_time() uses dt.timestamp() when dt is timezone-aware (required for aware utcnow())
_not_valid_after/_not_valid_before return UTC-aware datetimes for comparison with utcnow()
zip2tar timeshift uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) with aware utcnow()
last_modified uses utcnow().timestamp() instead of time.mktime on aware datetime

guesses.assumed: default API key expiry still strips tzinfo to naive UTC; unix_time() handles naive expires values
legacy not_valid_after/before naive cert fields are UTC wall times
